_comment: Four target personas. 'queries' are LinkedIn people-search keyword strings; {company} is substituted. 'notes' are tried longest-first and the first one that fits LinkedIn's 300-char invite limit wins.

hiring_manager.label: Hiring manager / AI & data lead
hiring_manager.why: A yes here often converts straight to an interview. Slowest to accept.
queries: "{company}" ("Data Science" OR "Decision Science") (Head OR Director OR Manager)
notes: Hi {first}, saw {company} is hiring {a_role}. I'm an engineer ({exp}) deliberately moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery. Would value connecting and following how your team adopts AI.
Hi {first}, saw {company_poss} {role} opening. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis - SAP/CRM requirements, now low-code. Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, saw {company_poss} {role} role. Engineer moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect.

recruiter_inhouse.label: In-house recruiter / TA
recruiter_inhouse.why: High accept rate and fast, but they screen on keyword fit - lead with the role name.
notes: Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role} ({location}). Engineer, {exp}: SAP/CRM requirement gathering plus low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI). Moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), SAP/CRM requirements + low-code. Happy to share my CV - would love to connect.
Hi {first}, I've applied to {company_poss} {role}. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI). Would love to connect.

peer_in_role.label: Peer already in the role
peer_in_role.why: Referrals are the highest-conversion path in India. Ask about their move, never for a job in the first note.
notes: Hi {first}, you're doing the kind of {role} work at {company} I'm working toward. I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirements, now low-code - moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.
Hi {first}, you do the {role} work at {company} I'm aiming for. Engineer ({exp}) moving into AI-enabled business analysis. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.
Hi {first}, you're in the {role} work I'm aiming for. Would love to connect and hear how you made the move.

agency_recruiter.label: Agency / staffing recruiter
agency_recruiter.why: Highest lead volume, lowest quality per lead. Give them your parameters up front so they filter themselves.
queries: "Business Analyst" Recruiter (Gurugram OR "Delhi NCR" OR Mumbai) staffing
notes: Hi {first}, I see you place AI/analytics talent in India. I'm an engineer ({exp}) - SAP/CRM requirement gathering, low-code delivery, B.Tech CSE (AI) - targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles in Delhi NCR, Mumbai or remote. Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, you place AI/analytics talent in India. Engineer ({exp}), B.Tech CSE (AI), targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles (Delhi NCR/Mumbai/remote). Would love to connect.
Hi {first}, engineer ({exp}) targeting AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles in India. Would love to connect.

followup_after_accept: Thanks for connecting, {first}! I'm focused on AI & Automation / D&T analyst roles - {exp} as an engineer (SAP/CRM requirement gathering, now low-code delivery), B.Tech CSE (AI). If something entry-level opens at {company}, I'd love to be considered - happy to send my CV.
